  • Eine spannende Herausforderung, in der du dich weiterentwickeln kannst, rundum den Bereich Artistmanagement Medien/Social Media, Influencer Marketing und den dazugehörigen Technologien (Software Systeme)
  • Perfekt abgestimmte selbst entwickelte Softwaresysteme für dich als Artistmanager/in und für deine Artists
  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Position in einem engagierten Team
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
  • Freiraum zum aktiven Gestalten durch flache Hierarchien und flexible Strukturen
  • Ein vielseitiges, anspruchsvolles und spannendes Aufgabengebiet mit renommierten Kunden
  • So sieht Work-Life-Balance aus: 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Konstruktives Feedback wird gerne gesehen
  • Unsere Firmenkultur hat offene Türen & Ohren, coole Kolleg*innen und Spaß bei der Arbeit
  • Ein hochmotiviertes, leistungsfähiges Team, welches gemeinsam arbeitet - aber auch gerne gemeinsame Erfolge feiert.
  • Mitgestalten statt nur mitschwimmen - aktive Mitarbeit an fachlichen und kulturellen Themen die auch über den Tellerand hinausgehen
  • Firmenhandy
  • Firmenlaptop

Aufgaben

Welche Aufgaben hättest Du?

  • Leitung des Teams als Hauptansprechpartner für interne Talente.
  • Verantwortung für die Akquise neuer Kooperationspartner, Erstellung von Angeboten und Bearbeitung eingehender Anfragen.
  • Ausübung von Verhandlungsgeschick bei Vertragsabschlüssen und Preisverhandlungen mit Anbietern und Dienstleistern.
  • Entwicklung von Konzepten und Content-Formaten in Zusammenarbeit mit den Talenten sowie Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung.
  • Koordination zwischen den Talenten und unseren Partnern, Planung ihrer Einsätze und Sicherstellung ihres Wohlbefindens.
  • Identifizierung und Akquisition potenzieller neuer Talente für bestehende und zukünftige Formate und Sendungen.
  • Förderung einer zukunftsorientierten Arbeitsweise und Schaffung neuer Möglichkeiten jenseits des reinen Künstlerdaseins in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Talenten

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit:

  • mind. 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Artistmanagement, Influencer Marketing, Online Marketing z.B. in einer Digital, Social Media oder PR-Agentur
  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse und feines Gespür für die aktuellsten Entwicklungen im digitalen Sektor sowie Verhalten der Konsumenten, insbesondere im Hinblick auf neue Trends und Technologien.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit allen gängigen Social Medien und Online-Communities
  • Erfahrung in der Umsetzung und/oder der Konzeption von Social Media und Influencer Marketing Kampagnen
  • Hohe Kreativität und Motivation, um innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Über uns:

Die Lionflence ist ein Unternehmen, welches sich auf Online Marketing, sowie Management spezialisiert hat. Aktuell ist der Hauptsitz in Mülheim an der Ruhr und wir sind auch in Berlin Spandau vertreten. (Eiswerderinsel)

Zudem unterstützen wir Unternehmen im Bereich Markenaufbau und entwickeln eigene Softwaresysteme. Es erwartet Dich ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien.

Als Circle-of-Marketing bieten wir Kunden ein umfassendes 360°-Dienstleistungspaket und somit auch Services, die über die gewohnten Dienstleistungen einer Marketing-Agentur hinausgehen.Unser idealer Kandidat ist ein Teamplayer mit ausgeprägten Fähigkeiten im Bereich zwischenmenschlicher Kommunikation und verfügt über praktische Erfahrung.Du hast ein starkes Interesse Artists zu betreuen und möchtest ab sofort spannende Aufgaben in dem Bereich Artist Management übernehmen?Du organisierst leidenschaftlich gerne und bist ein aufgeschlossener Mensch? Dann könntest du perfekt zu uns passen!

Darüber hinaus sollten folgende Fähigkeiten gegeben sein: Eigeninitiative und Ergebnisorientierung Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie Authentisches Auftreten und Kreativität Teamorientierung und Verlässlichkeit Selbstdisziplin und selbstständiges Arbeiten Benefits Wir sind ein junges, dynamisches und zielorientiertes Team, welches schnell am wachsen ist. Da uns die Arbeitsatmosphäre (Zielorientiert am gemeinsamen Erfolg und sehr harmonisch) genauso wichtig ist, wie die Ergebnisorientierung / Zielerreichung, gibt es bei uns eine Start-Up-Mentalität, gemeinsam etwas großes erreichen zu wollen. Dies spürt jeder von Beginn an. Es ist bei uns nicht der klassische 9-5 Job, denn bei uns ist die Atmosphäre so, dass jeder von sich aus, um am Erfolg zu arbeiten (Am persönlichen- aber auch gemeinsamen Erfolg) selbständig länger bleibt. Auch um den Abend des Öfteren auf der großen Dachterrasse ausklingen zu lassen. Bei guter Leistung: Zusätzlich werden Sie mit neuen Ipad Pro's ausgestatten und wir bieten Ihnen durch mehrere Online-Schulungen eine fundierte Ausbildung zum Versicherungs- und Finanzanlagenfachmann mit zertifiziertem IHK-Abschluss nach §34d und §34f. Somit haben Sie lebenslänglich die Lizenz, Finanzdienstleistungsprodukte wie bspw. Fonds zu vermitteln. Sollten Sie das Praktikum mit Bravour bestehen, gibt es viele Karrieremöglichkeiten bspw. als angehende Führungskraft oder Spezialist in einem Fachgebiet im Unternehmen. raw.title: Junior CRM Manager (m/f/d)
raw.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

Your Tasks

You will report to our Head of CRM and work alongside three CRM colleagues. You will also work closely with our Design, Website and Customer Support teams, as well as our Marketing Campaign Coordinator.

  • Plan and execute email and SMS campaigns that drive customer retention and engagement, in line with our commercial calendar and product launches.

  • Support the creation of our newsletters by writing engaging content and collaborating with the Design team to ensure a user-friendly format and appealing visuals.

  • Build and optimize automated flows in Klaviyo, such as welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase and winback.

  • Create customer segments based on purchase behavior and engagement, and tailor content to them.

  • Analyze customer data and behaviors to identify trends and opportunities for engagement and retention in collaboration with the rest of the CRM team and our in-house Data team.

  • Set up A/B tests on subject lines, content and send times, analyze the results and recommend which changes to roll out.

  • Monitor the performance of campaigns and flows (open rate, click rate, conversion, CRM revenue), spot what works and what doesn't, and proactively suggest improvements.

Your Profile

  • A university degree in Marketing, Business, Management or a related field.

  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience in CRM or email marketing, ideally in e-commerce or beauty.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. German, French, Spanish, or Italian language is an advantage.

  • Confident with Excel or Google Sheets. Hands-on experience with an email marketing or CRM tool, ideally Klaviyo.

  • Curious about AI and comfortable using AI tools in your daily work, for example to analyze data, brainstorm copy or automate repetitive tasks, while keeping a critical eye on the results.

  • A customer-first mindset combined with an analytical approach: you want to understand what our customers need and use data to see what works.

  • Detail-oriented, eager to learn and proactive in solving problems.

  • A feel for engaging copy and an eye for design, so our newsletters look as good as they perform.

  • A team player with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.

  • A personal connection to our values: you care about clean, sustainable beauty and want to help grow a brand you believe in.

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><h3><strong>Life at THG Beauty&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior Paid Media Executive at LOOKFANTASTIC?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></h3> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone with experience managing digital advertising campaigns who wants to take the next step in their career within a fast-paced e-commerce environment. You'll play a key role in bringing media plans to life across platforms such as Meta and TikTok, monitoring performance, making data-led optimisations and reporting on campaign success.</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">The role sits within THG Beauty's Retail Media structure, working closely with brand marketing leads, buying, trading, performance marketing and creative teams to deliver impactful, brand-funded media campaigns.</p> <p>You'll act as an external-facing LOOKFANTASTIC ambassador and media specialist, building relationships with our brand partners and helping them maximise their investment through effective digital activation.</p> <p>As a <strong>Senior Paid Media Executive</strong>, you'll:</p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships with LOOKFANTASTIC's key brand partners, understanding their objectives and developing data-driven paid media strategies to drive brand growth.</li> <li>Develop, pitch and activate multi-platform digital media plans across relevant paid social and digital advertising channels.</li> <li>Take hands-on ownership of campaign activation across platforms, including Meta Business Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, managing campaign set-up, implementation and ongoing performance.</li> <li>Monitor live campaign performance, proactively identifying opportunities to optimise targeting, creative, budgets and delivery against agreed KPIs and ROI targets.</li> <li>Own mid-campaign and post-campaign reporting, analysing performance data, identifying key insights and demonstrating campaign uplift and return on investment.</li> <li>Translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for brand partners, helping shape future media strategies and secure incremental investment.</li> <li>Work collaboratively with our influencer team to commission high-quality influencer assets for paid media repurposing.</li> <li>Support social-first creative and ad copy development, briefing our in-house creative team to deliver engaging, high-performing assets.</li> <li>Work closely with wider marketing, e-commerce, buying and trading teams to ensure campaigns are aligned with wider commercial objectives.</li> <li>Keep up to date with emerging digital platforms, advertising features and industry trends, bringing new ideas and opportunities to improve campaign performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills and experience do I need for this role?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>2+ years' experience in paid media, digital marketing or digital campaign activation.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on experience with paid media platforms</strong>, ideally Meta Business Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, with confidence setting up, managing and optimising campaigns.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data, monitor KPIs and produce meaningful performance reports.</li> <li>A commercial mindset, understanding how to use media investment effectively to drive performance, growth and ROI.</li> <li>Confidence working with campaign budgets, targeting, creative testing and optimisation.</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently present campaign recommendations to external brand partners.</li> <li>A proactive, digitally savvy individual who naturally keeps up with emerging platforms, social trends and developments in the paid media landscape.</li> <li>Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.</li> <li>A passion for beauty, e-commerce and the evolving retail media industry.</li> </ul> title: Value Consultant
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with near zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Value Consulting team The Pricing & Innovation team helps customers get the most from hx Renew, our market-leading SaaS pricing platform, and helps prospects and customers understand the value hx can create across pricing, underwriting and AI. Within it, Value Consulting turns complex customer problems into clear business cases, analysis and value stories that support better commercial decisions. The team sits at the heart of our go-to-market motion, building the business cases and ROI stories that unlock strategic enterprise opportunities and drive adoption, expansion and long-term growth. You will work as a bridge between Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior customer stakeholders, turning ambiguous problems into quantified value stories that strengthen commercial conversations. We are a small, high-ownership team. The culture is analytical, commercially minded and highly collaborative, with a strong expectation of independence, learning agility and comfort operating without a fully established playbook. What you’ll be doing Build clear, data-driven business cases and ROI models that quantify the financial impact of hx for prospects and customers, helping them make confident buying decisions. Partner with Sales on strategic enterprise opportunities, getting involved early to shape tailored value narratives that accelerate deal cycles and increase win rates. Run value workshops with stakeholders from junior underwriters to actuarial, pricing, transformation and executive leaders. Develop benchmarking, ROI analysis and customer insight that give Sales and senior leaders compelling proof points for executive-level conversations. Translate complex customer problems, workflows and data into simple, credible value stories. Build the reusable models, benchmarks and templates that let Account Executives run a first-pass value case themselves on standard deals, so your time goes to the deals that need your judgement. Continuously refine how we work, using AI and other tools to improve efficiency and impact. What you’ll need to have done Built robust business cases or ROI models for a technical or data-driven product, using clear assumptions and logic to demonstrate measurable commercial impact, that a buyer used to make a decision. Presented numbers to a sceptical commercial or technical audience and held your ground when challenged. Taken messy data and ambiguous customer problems through to clear, actionable recommendations, without close direction. Translated complex quantitative analysis into simple, executive-ready stories or presentations that have influenced decision makers. Worked cross-functionally with Sales, Product and Customer Success (or similar teams) to align on value drivers, messaging and success criteria. Pushed back when a number was being stretched, because the case needed to be right. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer highly defined, static playbooks and feel uncomfortable operating in ambiguity or helping to build the motion as you go. You are not motivated by digging into the details of financial models, customer data and assumptions to create credible, defensible analysis. You find it difficult to challenge or influence senior stakeholders, or you avoid direct collaboration with Sales on commercial outcomes. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Interview process Initial call with our Talent team (30 minutes) Hiring Manager interview (1 hour) Skills assessment (1 hour) Values interview (1 hour) Meet the CEO Our commitment to Diversity hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Next steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome. For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page. Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations.   • Partner with Sales on strategic enterprise opportunities, getting involved early to shape tailored value narratives that accelerate deal cycles and increase win rates.

  • Run value workshops with stakeholders from junior underwriters to actuarial, pricing, transformation and executive leaders.

  • Develop benchmarking, ROI analysis and customer insight that give Sales and senior leaders compelling proof points for executive-level conversations.

  • Translate complex customer problems, workflows and data into simple, credible value stories.

  • Build the reusable models, benchmarks and templates that let Account Executives run a first-pass value case themselves on standard deals, so your time goes to the deals that need your judgement.

  • Continuously refine how we work, using AI and other tools to improve efficiency and impact.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Built robust business cases or ROI models for a technical or data-driven product, using clear assumptions and logic to demonstrate measurable commercial impact, that a buyer used to make a decision.

  • Presented numbers to a sceptical commercial or technical audience and held your ground when challenged.

  • Taken messy data and ambiguous customer problems through to clear, actionable recommendations, without close direction.

  • Translated complex quantitative analysis into simple, executive-ready stories or presentations that have influenced decision makers.

  • Worked cross-functionally with Sales, Product and Customer Success (or similar teams) to align on value drivers, messaging and success criteria.

  • Pushed back when a number was being stretched, because the case needed to be right.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer highly defined, static playbooks and feel uncomfortable operating in ambiguity or helping to build the motion as you go.

  • You are not motivated by digging into the details of financial models, customer data and assumptions to create credible, defensible analysis.

  • You find it difficult to challenge or influence senior stakeholders, or you avoid direct collaboration with Sales on commercial outcomes.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager interview (1 hour)

  3. Skills assessment (1 hour)

  4. Values interview (1 hour)

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

General • Keep learning the connector platform, the clinical-trial data domain and cloud and software development best practices. • Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for this role and assigned by the manager/supervisor. REQUIRED SKILLS • Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues in plain language to non-technical clients and to write concise ticket updates and emails. • A client-service mindset: responsive, calm under pressure, and takes ownership of a ticket until it is resolved or properly handed over. • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills: forms a hypothesis, checks logs and data, and proves the root cause with evidence before concluding. • Strong attention to detail with data, such as identifiers, dates, time zones and character encodings. • Good time management: balances planned development work with interrupt-driven support, prioritizing by client impact. • Works collaboratively within a team, asks for help early, and is self-motivated and eager to learn. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS • Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. • 0–1 years of experience in software development, technical support or cloud-based application support; internships and substantial academic or personal projects count. • Working knowledge of C# and the .NET framework: able to read and debug existing code and deliver small features. • Familiarity with AWS, particularly Lambda, S3, SQS and CloudWatch Logs. • Working SQL skills (joins, filtering, aggregation) on relational databases, preferably MySQL. • Understanding of REST APIs and of JSON, XML and CSV data; experience calling APIs with Postman or similar tools. • Understanding of data parsing and mapping techniques, including handling of dates, null values and encodings. • Experience or familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git). DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE • Experience with LocalStack for local AWS cloud application development. • Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools. • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. • Prior experience in customer-facing support, or with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceDesk Plus. • Exposure to clinical research systems and concepts (EDC, CTMS, eTMF; study, site, subject, visit) or to regulated (GxP) software environments. • Scripting (Python or shell) for data checks and log analysis. • Familiarity with containerization and microservices architecture. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Learn more at <a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><p>Verve For Advertisers is a technology company that empowers brands and agencies to target audiences based on declared intent, following them from initial curiosity to ultimate decisioning, to drive measurable outcomes.</p> <p>We've unified the company's demand-side offering under the VFA name, bringing together the largest on-site search-intent dataset outside of walled gardens — built on data partnerships with 3M+ websites, LLM chat signals, and survey data — and premium inventory grounded in our direct SDK integrations. Our technology captures both what consumers do and why they do it, delivering high-fidelity audiences, insights, and outcomes across premium omnichannel inventory.</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Verve is building a Brand Direct function — a small, senior team that sells and services select brand accounts directly, alongside our existing agency relationships, rather than replacing them. The goal is to get Verve's data, formats, and capabilities into brand planning conversations earlier, and to prove that dedicated brand-side support grows accounts faster than agency coverage alone.</p> <p>This is a new team and a founding hire. You'll help define what “brand direct” looks like at Verve in practice, working closely with the Global VP of Brand Partnerships from day one.</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>As Brand Partnerships Director, UK, you'll own a portfolio of named brand accounts in the UK, working as a generalist across categories rather than a single vertical. This is a senior individual contributor role — not a people-management role in the first instance — designed for someone who wants to build something and has the option to grow into managing a local team as the function scales.</p> <p>You are a hunter first: someone who can open doors at brand (not agency) level, build credibility fast, and turn a first meeting into a durable, revenue-generating relationship. Prior experience or relationships in a specific vertical (e.g. CPG/Retail, Travel, Finance, Beauty/Lux) are a strong plus, as this role has the potential to grow into leading a vertical specialist team.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities include</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build senior brand relationships — Owning relationships at CMO, Global Head of Media, and VP of Brand level, along with key line-of-business leads such as Data, Creative, and Measurement within the brand.</li> <li>Get ahead of the brief — Getting into brand planning cycles early so Verve's data, formats, and capabilities are already part of the conversation before the brief reaches the agency.</li> <li>Represent Verve in the room — Representing Verve at brand-side (not agency-side) forums, marketing conferences, and roundtables to build Verve's profile with brand teams directly.</li> <li>Commission insight work — Working with the insights and data teams to build brand-specific audience stories, category reports, and trend pieces that give brands a reason to meet and stay engaged.</li> <li>Secure Joint Business Plans — Working towards annual brand frameworks that lock in investment and strategic commitment at brand level, independent of which agency holds the account.</li> <li>Run the pilot — Building and pitching a defined target list of named accounts, with revenue tracked separately from non-brand-direct-supported business to prove the model.</li> <li>Co-sell, don't compete — Partner with the existing agency sales team under a joint commercial framework — this role is additive to agency relationships, not competitive with them; revenue is double-counted so both sides are incentivized to collaborate.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Here are a few indicators that you're the right person</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br></span></p> <ul> <li>You have a track record of building and owning senior client relationships directly with brands or marketers, not solely through an agency or intermediary.</li> <li>You have genuine “hunter” instincts — you're comfortable prospecting, opening new doors, and creating momentum in a newly-created role with no existing playbook.</li> <li>You have an existing network of brand-side contacts in the UK; a specific category or vertical angle (e.g. CPG/Retail, Travel, Finance, Beauty/Lux) is a plus but not required.</li> <li>You're comfortable with ambiguity and building process as you go — this is a Phase 1 hire into a function that will evolve quickly.</li> <li>You have strong commercial instincts: you can read an account's growth potential and prioritize your time accordingly.</li> <li>You bring experience in media, adtech, data, or a related commercial sales environment as helpful context, though the core skill this role requires is brand-side relationship building.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Stay healthy with our<strong>&nbsp;Bupa HealthCare Plan</strong>&nbsp;with easy access to medical care</li> <li>Support your long-term financial security with our&nbsp;<strong>Aviva Corporate Pension Scheme</strong>, with Verve contributing 5% of your qualifying earnings</li> <li>Pick what matters most to you in our&nbsp;<strong>Personalized Benefits Platform,&nbsp;</strong>with a budget of<strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong>£50/month</li> <li>Recharge with&nbsp;<strong>25 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days&nbsp;</strong>throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays</li> </ul> <p><strong>Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget &amp; internal webinars</strong>… and even more reasons to join us!<br><br><strong>Communications regarding your application will only come from ----- or ----- email addresses.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.&nbsp;<br><br>If you are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, <a href="https://verve.com/california-applicant-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">click here</a> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.<br></span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">If you are located in the EU or UK visit our&nbsp;</span><a style="font-size: 8pt;" href="https://verve.com/applicant-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a><span style="font-size: 8pt;"> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.

  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.

  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.

  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager
raw.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

About the Role

Summary

Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups.

 

We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line.

 

This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability.

  • A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window.

  • Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter.

  • Enablement coverage: 100% of shipped capabilities in the owned area have current capability documentation and a delivered briefing to support and solutions engineering at or before release.

  • Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release.

  • Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding.

What You'll Do

  • Own inbound product direction for your area. Research emerging agentic AI capabilities, attacker techniques, and adjacent standards (MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic-security guidance, agent identity frameworks) to determine what MARS for Agents should build next across the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy.

  • Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write.

  • Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release.

  • Validate before you specify. Use AI coding assistants, MCP clients, and agent runtimes hands-on to prototype and stress-test proposed behavior — so requirements are grounded in how agents actually behave, not just how they are documented to behave. Define success metrics for what you ship and track them post-release.

  • Enable the field. Brief technical support and solutions engineering on new and existing capabilities, and maintain current capability documentation for your area that clearly separates documented and shipping facts from planned work and open questions, so the field never over-promises. Be the trusted authority on what your part of MARS does today, what is coming, and what it deliberately does not do yet.

  • Engage customers, sales, and marketing. Join customer and prospect conversations periodically to gather requirements, pressure-test positioning, and support technical evaluations; support the sales team with technical Q&A, competitive objection-handling, and input on proposals and decks; and work with product marketing on messaging, positioning, and launch content.

  • Run competitive analysis that changes decisions. Continuously track competitors relevant to MARS for Agents — network/SSE-SASE incumbents (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope), agent-identity and IAM players (Okta, CyberArk), MCP gateway vendors, and emerging agent-security pure-plays — and maintain a clear point of view on where MARS leads, where it currently trails, and what capabilities are commoditizing. Feed those findings directly into requirements, positioning, and roadmap prioritization.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • 6–10+ years of product management or product owner experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise infrastructure, or security software, including a track record of owning a complex, technical product area end to end.

  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, engineering-ready requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) and to own a backlog end to end for a technically complex product surface.

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy. This role receives strategic direction rather than daily instruction, and the person in it should be able to take a goal and drive it through research, requirements, engineering partnership, and launch across multiple related surfaces at once — with the support of a collaborative product and engineering team.

  • Comfort operating at high velocity. Our engineering organization runs agile at a fast cadence, and this role also helps bring the process and rigor needed to make the product scalable, so both muscles matter.

  • Solid working knowledge of AI agent technology: how LLMs and AI agents operate, the difference between autonomous and human-in-the-loop (hybrid) agents, tool and function calling, and — specifically — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem (servers, clients, tool calls) at a depth sufficient to write requirements for an MCP Server and an MCP Proxy, not just discuss them conceptually.

  • Real cybersecurity background, with working familiarity in areas such as identity and access management, proxy and gateway architectures (forward proxy, reverse proxy, secure web gateway / SSE / SASE), and content or traffic inspection. Deep specialization in every area is not required, but enough fluency to engage credibly with engineering and with technical customers is.

  • Hands-on, regular personal use of AI tools — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code / Cowork, GitHub Copilot, or similar — including some exposure to how they use MCP or other tool-calling integrations.

  • Strong written communication, since the role produces a steady stream of specs, FAQs, and internal enablement material.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 Copilot ecosystem: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Microsoft's Entra/Azure agent identity plane — enough to scope and write requirements for a two-way integration in which MARS augments Microsoft's own agent governance rather than competing with it.

  • Prior product ownership of an identity or registry system, a proxy or gateway product, or an API/integration platform.

  • Direct experience with MCP, LLM/agent tool-calling architectures, or building integrations with Claude or other frontier model providers.

  • Familiarity with OWASP frameworks, including emerging OWASP guidance for agentic AI security.

  • Experience directly supporting a technical sales motion — SE enablement, competitive battlecards, customer discovery calls.

  • Experience at a company scaling a new product line or product category from early traction.

  • Experience using AI-assisted research or analysis tooling as part of a regular product workflow — for example synthesizing customer feedback at volume, or building lightweight prototypes to validate requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Menlo Mindsets

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

  • Proactive Leadership — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.

    • What it looks like in this role: You receive strategic direction, not a task list — and you are expected to decide what your surfaces should build next, act on it, and keep the Head of Product and your partners informed as you go.

  • Straight Talk — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.

    • What it looks like in this role: You publish an honest competitive point of view, including where MARS currently trails, and you keep documentation that clearly separates what ships today from what is planned so the field never over-promises.

  • United Impact — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.

  • Elevated Talent — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.

  • Customer-Compelled — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.

    • What it looks like in this role: You sit in customer and prospect conversations regularly, support live technical evaluations, and carry what you hear straight back into requirements rather than filing it away as research.

About Menlo Security

Menlo Security's mission: Enabling humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely without compromise. Menlo Security's patented Isolation platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by eliminating the threat of malware from the web, documents, and email. description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing. You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset. Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing. 🚀 What you'll own Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members. Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team. Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on. Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time. Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers. Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team. Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows. Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets. Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process. Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution. Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation. Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control. Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation. Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support. Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus. CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion. Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team. Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them. Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration. A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time. Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote. ⭐️ Bonus points Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in. Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures. Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows. Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness). Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

  • Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

  • Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

  • Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

  • Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.

  • Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

  • Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.

  • Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets.

  • Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.

  • Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

  • Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

  • Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

  • Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

  • Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

  • Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.

  • CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

  • Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.

  • Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.

  • Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

  • Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).

  • Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

Develop, maintain, and optimize ServiceNow integrations with internal and external systems using REST, SOAP, JDBC, and other integration protocols. Support ServiceNow platform upgrades, enhancements, customizations, and continuous development. Design, implement, and administer backup and recovery solutions, including Veeam and HPE StoreOnce. Administer enterprise storage technologies, including traditional SAN, NAS, Ceph, vSAN, and distributed file systems. Administer server infrastructure, including blade systems, composable infrastructure, and Oracle platforms such as Exadata and Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA). Administer OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) and supporting technologies, including Red Hat Service Mesh, GitHub, Helm, GitOps, Ansible Automation Platform, and Kafka. Develop, execute, maintain, and troubleshoot automation scripts using Ansible and PowerShell. Administer Active Directory, LDAP, Keycloak, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and digital certificate lifecycle processes. Administer and maintain monitoring and observability platforms, including Nagios, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Fluentd, Kibana, and Jaeger. Administer mail servers and mail relays, including Postfix, antivirus, and anti-spam solutions. Support database environments, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and Elasticsearch. Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions in collaboration with stakeholders and technical teams. Ensure the reliability, performance, security, and interoperability of ServiceNow integrations with internal and external systems. Maintain the accuracy, integrity, security, and compliance of data exchanged between ServiceNow and connected systems. title: Project Quality Manager
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Project Quality Manager, you own the Project & Program pillar of Harmattan’s Quality organization. You set the quality standards that carry every programme from first prototypes through to mass production. You lead the Project Quality Engineers and act as the quality counterpart of Program Management, Engineering and our institutional customers. Your work keeps quality gates rigorous at the right level for each development phase, in line with ISO 9001 / EN 9100. Responsibilities Leadership & Team Building Lead, coach and grow the Project Quality Engineering team, and allocate engineers across active programmes. Act as the quality counterpart of Program Management, Engineering leads and institutional customers. Standardize project quality practices across programmes and turn lessons learned into company standards. Quality Gates & Product Development Own quality gate governance from EVT to PVT and transfer to mass production, including go/no-go recommendations. Drive advanced product quality planning (APQP / EN 9145): quality plans, DFMEA / PFMEA, special characteristics and control plans. Ensure design and development quality per EN 9100: design reviews, verification and validation evidence, configuration and change control. Arbitrate open development non-conformities, risks and deviations, and lead structured problem solving. Customer Deliverables & Performance Deliver customer quality documentation, including quality and management plans and qualification and acceptance files. Prepare customer audits and delivery verification readiness together with Site Quality. Align with Supplier Quality and Industrialization on first article inspection and production readiness. Define and report project quality KPIs, including risks, non-conformities and gate readiness, reviewed regularly with Programs. Candidate Requirements Engineering degree (MSc or equivalent) in quality, aeronautical, mechanical, electronics or systems engineering. 8+ years in project, programme or design quality in aerospace, defense, automotive or high-tech hardware. 2 to 3+ years leading a team, or leading quality on a full programme. Strong command of EN 9100 / ISO 9001, APQP / PPAP (EN 9145), DFMEA / PFMEA, control plans, design reviews and 8D. Experience taking complex electromechanical or embedded products through EVT / DVT / PVT to serial production. Structured and pragmatic, applying the right level of rigor per phase and holding firm at gates when needed. Knowledge of AQAP 2110 and defense customer requirements is a plus; comfort with Jira and Confluence. Regular on-site presence at the production site, alongside Paris-based work. Fluency in French and English required. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

About the role

  • Embed directly within a product team. Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.

  • Own ML projects end to end. Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.

  • Make the build vs. buy decision. Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.

  • Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

  • Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

  • Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

  • Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

  • Write production code. Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.

  • Own quality in production. Build sound evaluations, monitor performance and investigate failures once the feature is live.

About You

  • You've shipped ML into production. You have 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping ML-powered products, with strong experience in PyTorch or equivalent frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX.

  • You have applied-science depth. You can fine-tune vision or diffusion models, design meaningful evaluations and debug training runs when necessary.

  • You're a pragmatic builder. You care about solving the customer's problem rather than proving that your own model is the best approach. You'll happily use an external model, API or existing library when that's the fastest route to value.

  • You're product-minded. You measure success through shipped features, user behaviour and business outcomes rather than papers or benchmarks alone.

  • You're comfortable in production codebases. You can move between experimentation and production engineering, writing maintainable code that lives inside a real product.

  • You have strong ownership. You're comfortable taking an ambiguous ML problem, deciding what matters, choosing an approach and driving it through to production.

  • You iterate quickly. You enjoy short feedback loops and would rather ship something useful, learn from users and improve it than spend months optimising something that hasn't reached production.

  • You're curious and collaborative. You can both explain your expertise and learn from the deep technical expertise around you. You value knowledge sharing and humility.

  • You're fluent in English. French isn't required.

Nice to have: experience shipping generative image models or diffusion models into production; experience evaluating third-party AI APIs against internal alternatives; experience working in a fast-growing startup or directly within a product team.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity

  • Hybrid working from our Paris headquarters

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support up to €10,000

  • MacBook Pro

  • Private healthcare

  • Regular company off-sites and team retreats

  • International English-speaking team
