raw.description:
About Genesis

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

The role

General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too.

You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area.

You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently.

What you will do

  • Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection work and help the team scale effectively.

  • Own complex collection setups. Take a loosely defined request and turn it into a working, repeatable collection task, including the setup, fixtures, props, environment, and procedure, with minimal support from engineering.

  • Create high-quality training data. Wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and produce precise demonstrations that can be used to train our models.

  • Own the full collection workflow. Go beyond collecting the data itself: review and quality-check your work, identify unusable episodes, support annotation, and help ensure that what reaches research is trainable data.

  • Build repeatable tasks. Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators.

  • Partner with research and model engineering. Translate their requests into physical collection tasks, share observations from the floor, and iterate with them on setups and collection strategy.

  • Improve the operation. Identify when a fixture, station layout, procedure, or collection method can be improved and proactively help implement those improvements.

  • Write and improve the playbook. Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar.

  • Guide other operators. Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team.

  • Run real-robot testing. Partner with reliability and engineering teams to test robots on the floor, document what you observe, and help surface issues.

  • Own quality. Review your own work and the team's, take direct feedback, and keep raising the bar.

What we are looking for

  • You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment.

  • Hands-on robot or glove-based data collection experience is a strong plus, but not a requirement. This kind of data collection is new, and we will teach you our specific tools and approach.

  • You build, not just run. Give you a vague request and a scrappy setup, and you can turn it into a clean, repeatable task with the right fixtures, environment, process, and written procedure.

  • You can operate autonomously. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex collection tasks with limited day-to-day support from engineering.

  • You understand quality beyond collection. You can review your work, recognize when collected data is unusable or below the quality bar, and understand why.

  • You are ready to lead. You have trained, mentored, or led others doing hands-on work and want to help establish the execution and quality standard for a growing team.

  • You work well with research and engineering teams. You can translate their requests into physical collection tasks and turn what you observe during collection into useful feedback.

  • You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice the moment something about the setup, hardware, environment, procedure, or collected data is off.

  • You are technically handy. You are comfortable with Linux, some Python scripting to automate repetitive work, and hardware assembly and troubleshooting.

  • You are comfortable in a fast-moving environment. Hardware, processes, and collection methods will evolve quickly, and you are comfortable adapting while helping improve how the team works.

  • You communicate well in English. You will work daily with teams in Paris and the Bay Area across time zones. French is a plus.

  • Bonus: reliability testing. You have partnered with a reliability or test team on real-robot testing.

Working conditions and role constraints

  • Work takes place in production environments and technical laboratories.

  • Prolonged standing and repetitive hand and arm movements while wearing collection equipment, including gloves, head-mounted cameras, and headsets, for extended periods.

  • Handling and lifting of loads, including props, fixtures, robot equipment, and station equipment, up to 23 kg for station setup and reconfiguration.

Why this role

  • Real ownership. You will have meaningful ownership over how the Paris data collection floor operates and help set the standard the team grows toward.

  • Hands-on leadership. You will remain close to the work while helping guide other operators, improve execution, and raise the quality bar.

  • Build, not just execute. You will take ambiguous collection needs and turn them into reliable, repeatable tasks that can scale across the team.

  • A clear growth path. As the operation scales, this role can grow toward leading or supervising teams of operators or toward broader project and program management responsibilities.

  • The front line of the mission. The data you create, review, and improve is what teaches our robots to work.

title: Responsable HSE F/H/X
description: À propos de Symrise Symrise est un fournisseur mondial de fragrances, de parfums, d'arômes, d'ingrédients actifs cosmétiques et d'ingrédients fonctionnels. L'entreprise compte parmi les leaders mondiaux de son secteur et dessert des fabricants de parfums, de cosmétiques, de produits alimentaires et de boissons, ainsi que l'industrie pharmaceutique et les producteurs de compléments nutritionnels et d'aliments pour animaux. Vos missions Rattaché(e) au Secrétaire Général , avec un rattachement fonctionnel au Regional Head of Safety EAME , vous définissez, pilotez et faites évoluer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy. Véritable partenaire de la Direction du site et des responsables opérationnels, vous veillez à intégrer pleinement les enjeux EHS aussi bien dans les activités quotidiennes que dans les projets de transformation, de développement et d'investissement du site. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Définir et déployer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy , en cohérence avec les objectifs EHS globaux de Symrise et les priorités du business. Manager et développer l'équipe EHS , en définissant les priorités et en veillant à disposer des compétences et ressources nécessaires. Identifier, évaluer et prioriser les principaux risques environnementaux, santé et sécurité , et assurer la mise en œuvre de plans de prévention adaptés. Développer une véritable culture de la sécurité et de la prévention auprès de l'ensemble des activités du site : laboratoires, bureaux et fonctions support. Accompagner la Direction dans ses prises de décision en apportant votre expertise sur les risques EHS, les contraintes réglementaires et leurs impacts opérationnels . Intégrer les exigences EHS dès les premières étapes des projets de transformation, immobiliers, laboratoires et de développement du site . Piloter la conformité réglementaire et anticiper les évolutions de la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'EHS susceptibles d'impacter les activités du site. Développer et entretenir des relations constructives avec les autorités et parties prenantes externes, notamment l'Inspection du travail, la CRAMIF, les services de santé au travail ainsi que les autorités environnementales et locales . Représenter le site lors des inspections et audits réglementaires et assurer le suivi des plans d'action associés. Piloter les analyses d'incidents et garantir la mise en œuvre d'actions correctives et préventives durables. Suivre la performance EHS, les indicateurs clés et le reporting associé, dans une logique d' amélioration continue . Être l'interface privilégiée entre le site de Clichy et les équipes EHS régionales et globales de Symrise . Profil recherché Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Hygiène, Sécurité et Environnement (HSE/EHS), sciences environnementales, ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous justifiez d' au moins 10 ans d'expérience progressive dans une fonction EHS , idéalement acquise au sein d'une organisation internationale et dans des environnements complexes combinant activités industrielles, laboratoires ou opérations. Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons un profil capable d'allier vision stratégique et pragmatisme opérationnel . Vous vous distinguez notamment par : Une solide expertise en management EHS, évaluation des risques et conformité réglementaire . Une expérience confirmée dans le management et le développement d'équipes EHS . Une expérience significative dans l'accompagnement de projets de transformation, de développement ou d'investissement . Une bonne maîtrise des relations avec les autorités réglementaires et les parties prenantes externes. Une capacité à anticiper les risques et à transformer des problématiques EHS complexes en recommandations concrètes et pragmatiques pour le business . De solides compétences en leadership, en influence et en accompagnement du changement dans une organisation matricielle et internationale . Une excellente capacité à communiquer et à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment avec le senior management. De fortes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'aide à la décision. Une expérience en conduite du changement et en gouvernance de projets. Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais . Avantages Ce poste vous offre l'opportunité de prendre la responsabilité des enjeux EHS au sein d'un site stratégique de Symrise , en collaboration étroite avec la Direction locale ainsi qu'avec les équipes régionales et globales du Groupe. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement en transformation, où l'EHS joue un rôle essentiel dans la continuité des activités, le développement du site, l'excellence opérationnelle et la croissance durable . Au-delà des enjeux de conformité, vous aurez l'opportunité de façonner la feuille de route EHS du site de Clichy , d'influencer des décisions structurantes et de contribuer directement au développement d'une culture forte et proactive de la sécurité. Localisation : Clichy (92) Intitulé : EHS Manager – Site de Clichy Rémunération La rémunération proposée pour ce poste est de EUR 60,000–72,000 par an. Vos premiers mois chez Symrise Vous prenez en main la gestion des dossiers HSE du site de Clichy et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles. Votre période d'essai de 3 mois vous permet de vous familiariser avec nos standards de sécurité et nos exigences réglementaires. title: Location Data engineer
description: We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features. You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact. This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems. As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include: Making Sense of Data Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals. Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams. Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions. Building Data Products Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably. Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale. Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models. Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand. Exploring & Analyzing Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions. Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work. Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions. Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result. From Data to Intelligence Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter. Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem. Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability. Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production. Continuous Improvement Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure. Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies. Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack. Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning. Your Skills & Experience Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems. Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets. Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools. Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does. Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features. Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing. Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products. Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data. Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering. Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production. Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets. Life at amo To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you: We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A). We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light! Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover: Health care (100% coverage). Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%). Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year: 5 weeks of paid time off; 1–2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract); ~11 bank holidays. We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with: Help and sponsored visa process. 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival. Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home. Für ein langfristiges Projekt bei unserem Kunden in Zürich (Remote-Anteil nur innerhalb der Schweiz möglich) suchen wir einen Python Software Architekt (m/w/d).

Key Facts
Start: 01.01.2027
Dauer: 12 Monate /
Auslastung: 100 %
Einsatzart:
Einsatzort: Zürich
Einsatzland: Schweiz


Ihre Aufgaben

• Konzipieren und entwerfen von Python-Architekturen für Daten-, Service- und Automatisierungsplattformen sowie eigenständiges Lösen komplexer technischer Fragestellungen

• Entwickeln von Python-Lösungen für Datenanalyse, ETL, Data Science, GenAI/ML und Automatisierung

• Umsetzen und Weiterentwickeln von ETL-/ELT-Datenpipelines

• Entwickeln von Python-Services, Tools, Jobs und Automatisierungsskripten

• Strukturieren von Anwendungen mit klarer Trennung von Business Logic, Data Access und Orchestrierung

• Entwickeln von Microservice- oder joborientierten Architekturen und bei Bedarf deren Containerisierung

• Integrieren von Python-Lösungen über REST-Schnittstellen, Message Bus, Files und Data-Warehouse-Systeme

• Verantwortlich für das Integrieren und Weiterentwickeln der Lösungen innerhalb bestehender CI/CD- und Betriebsplattformen

• Arbeiten mit GitLab und Jenkins/CloudBees in Entwicklungs- und Lieferprozessen

• Umsetzen von Paketierungs- und Build-Prozessen, unter anderem mit setuptools

• Sicherstellen der Qualität mit pytest, coverage, pylint und black

• Einrichten und Nutzen von Python-Umgebungen mit Conda/Miniconda

• Verwalten von Containern und Artefakten über die vorhandenen Plattformen

• Mitwirken in agilen DevOps-Teams und kontinuierliches Weiterentwickeln von Entwicklungs- und Automatisierungsprozessen



Muss-Anforderungen

• Mehrjährige professionelle Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit Python und Erfahrung in mindestens einem relevanten Einsatzgebiet wie Data Engineering, ETL/ELT, Data Science, GenAI/ML oder Automatisierung

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung strukturierter und wartbarer Python-Anwendungen

• Architekturkenntnisse für Daten-, Service- und Automatisierungsplattformen sowie Erfahrung mit Architekturprinzipien zur klaren Trennung von Business Logic, Data Access und Orchestrierung

• Erfahrung im Design von ETL-/ELT-Datenpipelines

• Erfahrung mit Microservice- oder joborientierten Architekturen und Containerisierung

• Fundierte Kenntnisse von Integrationsarchitekturen und Schnittstellen, einschliesslich REST, Messaging, Files und/oder Data-Warehouse-Systemen

• Fähigkeit, Python-Lösungen in bestehende CI/CD- und Betriebsplattformen zu integrieren sowie Erfahrung mit pytest

• Gute Kenntnisse von Git/GitLab sowie Erfahrung mit CI/CD, automatisierten Tests und DevOps-Praktiken einschliesslich Security-by-Design

• Erfahrung mit agilen Vorgehensweisen wie Scrum oder Kanban

• Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte zu erstellen und komplexe technische Fragestellungen selbstständig zu konzipieren und zu lösen

• Offene Persönlichkeit mit einer raschen Auffassungsgabe

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift



Kann-Anforderungen

• Erfahrung mit coverage sowie idealerweise pylint und black als ergänzende Python-Qualitätssicherungswerkzeuge

• Versiert mit Jenkins für CI/CD

• Vertrautheit mit Python-Workbench-Tools wie IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm oder Visual Studio Code sowie Conda/Miniconda und setuptools



Weitere Informationen

- Einsatzdauer: Januar 2027 bis Dezember 2027 mit Option auf Verlängerung


- Pensum: 100%


- Einsatzort: Zürich & Remote (nur innerhalb der Schweiz möglich) - pro Woche

title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
description: About machineMD At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere. We’re building neurodiagnostics for the next generation with our neos™ device and oculometrics software. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test. The Role You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers. Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice. Automation Across the System – develop automated tests for complex, distributed systems across different frameworks and technologies, covering multiple components, interfaces, and end-to-end scenarios beyond UI testing. Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others. Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time. Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment. What We Look For Experience Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend. Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task. Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus. Qualifications Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage. Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field. Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration. How You Work Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. you choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop. Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found. Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn, lend a hand. Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives. Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases. Working at machineMD Based in Bern, Switzerland, with roughly 80% of your working time on-site (approximately four days a week at full-time employment) and Monday as our shared anchor day. At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere.

We’re building neurodiagnostics for the next generation with our neos™ device and oculometrics software. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test.

The Role

You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers.

  • Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice.

  • Automation Across the System – develop automated tests for complex, distributed systems across different frameworks and technologies, covering multiple components, interfaces, and end-to-end scenarios beyond UI testing.

  • Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others.

  • Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time.

  • Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment.

What We Look For

Experience

  • Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend.

  • Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task.

  • Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code.

  • Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus.

Qualifications

  • Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage.

  • Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field.

  • Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration.

How You Work

  • Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. you choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop.

  • Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found.

  • Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn, lend a hand.

  • Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives.

  • Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases.

  • Collaborative, in-person working, with flexibility to do your best work.

title: Android Developer
description: At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with your future colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare. We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer at Luscii, you will build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible. Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role. The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform. Your role As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps. What you will be doing: Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience. Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns. Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early. Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable. Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues. Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Most important benefits Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii). Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least five years of experience in Android or mobile development and extensive experience with Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow. You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment. You have experience with clean architecture, software design patterns and approaches such as MVVM or MVI, and you understand how to apply them in maintainable mobile applications. You have experience with Jetpack Compose, mobile unit and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and Android design guidelines. You understand mobile performance and reliability, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation, as well as working with web services, cloud platforms and APIs. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Front Office Stagiaire
description: Als Front Office Stagiaire ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze gasten! Wanneer zij voor het eerst het hotel binnenkomen geef jij ze een warm welkom in het hotel en help je bij het inchecken. Meelopen naar de kamer? Leuke dingen om te doen in de stad of lekkere restaurantjes om te eten? Voor jou is geen vraag te veel! Door jou ontbreekt het onze gasten aan niets als ze bij ons verblijven en wanneer zij uitchecken gaan zij met een grote glimlach de deur uit. Ook leer je tijdens de stage meer over de administratieve handelingen en verwerk je binnenkomende reserveringen. Tijdens jouw stage leer jij over soepel draaiende Front Office afdeling, en alles wat daarbij verder komt kijken. Door de dynamische werkomgeving is elke dag anders, en dat is nou nét wat deze stage zo leuk maakt. Hoe verschillend je dagen ook zijn, één ding blijft altijd hetzelfde; jij zorgt dat elke gast met een tevreden gevoel naar huis gaat. En jij zelf natuurlijk ook! Kan jij onze gasten een onvergetelijk verblijf geven? LEONARDO HOTEL PAPENDRECHT Vlakbij de Drechtsteden, met de natuur binnen handbereik, vind je Leonardo Hotel Papendrecht. Leonardo Hotel Papendrecht kent 87 moderne kamers en 10 volledig uitgeruste appartementen van ongeveer 100 m2. Ons hotel is het enige hotel in de Alblasserwaard en kent een klein, maar heel hecht team! Onze gasten hebben de mogelijkheid om Dordrecht en Rotterdam te bezoeken met de waterbus, over de Maas langs alle havens. Na een dagje sightseeing, een bezoek aan de Erasmusbrug of de bekende molens van Kinderdijk, kunnen onze gasten genieten van een heerlijke diner bij Chef’s! Food & Drinks. Deel jij jouw favoriete uitjes met onze gasten?  WIE BEN JIJ? Jij bent op zoek naar een stage die aansluit bij jouw (hotel)opleiding. Hospitality zit in jouw bloed en je hebt een passie voor het vak. Samenwerken doe jij graag! Je bent een echte team-player. Jij bent flexibel beschikbaar en onregelmatig werken vind jij geen probleem. Jij beschikt goede kennis over de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Deze stage is beschikbaar per 4 januari 2027. WAT KRIJG JIJ VAN ONS (NAAST EEN FIJN TEAM NATUURLIJK)? Als MBO student ontvang jij een stagevergoeding gebaseerd op €750,- bruto per maand fulltime, die bestaat uit €670,- stagevergoeding en €80,- onkostenvergoeding. Wij hanteren variabele betalingsperiodes van 4 of 5 weken per keer, volgens het aantal gewerkte dagen en gewerkte uren. Dus de ene maand krijg je wat minder en de andere maand wat meer. Ben jij opzoek naar een (bij)baan voor tijdens of na jouw studie? Dan ben je bij ons aan het goede adres! Wij bieden goede doorgroeimogelijkheden. title: Senior HR Adviseur
description: Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken? Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten. Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior HR Advisor : adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen; ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek; draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid; vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen; werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening; analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen; zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken; werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten. Wie ben jij?  Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig? Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen. Daarnaast breng je mee: een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld HRM, Human Resource Management, Bedrijfskunde of Arbeidsrecht; circa 2 tot 6 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bijvoorbeeld als Senior HR Advisor, HR Adviseur of in een vergelijkbare brede HR-rol; gedegen kennis van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht en sociale wetgeving; ervaring met complexe HR-casuïstiek, zoals verzuim, reorganisaties en arbeidsvoorwaarden; ervaring met strategische HR-projecten, beleidsontwikkeling of organisatieverandering; het vermogen om strategisch te adviseren én betrokken te blijven bij de operationele HR-praktijk; affiniteit met HR-technologie, HR-data, AFAS en procesoptimalisatie; uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; beschikbaarheid van 32 tot 40 uur per week. Wat bieden wij? In cijfers: Een bruto salaris tussen €4.000,00 en €5.000,00 o.b.v. 40 uur per week (op basis van je ervaring); Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé vinden wij belangrijk: 30 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om meer bij te kopen; 8% vakantiegeld; Voor je eigen duurzaamheid: Maak gratis en onbeperkt gebruik van onze eigen sportruimte "The Box" op de Priva Campus, met diverse lessen in bijvoorbeeld CrossFit, Pilates en Spinning; Deelname aan de pensioenregeling van Priva; Opleidingsmogelijkheden via onze eigen Priva Academy. Klaar om jouw HR-expertise in te zetten én écht invloed te hebben op hoe we HR binnen Priva verder ontwikkelen? Breng je strategische blik, praktische aanpak en verbetermentaliteit mee en bouw samen met ons aan een HR-organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst. Solliciteer als Senior HR Advisor en maak het verschil vanaf dag één. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Ben jij communicatief sterk en spreek je vloeiend Duits? Dan gaan we graag met jou in gesprek. Lees verder en ontdek of deze kans jouw volgende stap kan zijn. Vereisten Jij brengt mee: Geen ervaring nodig, je wordt goed ingewerkt. Fouten maken mag! Actieve werkhouding, je pakt makkelijk de telefoon. Gezelligheid: interesse in collega's, klanten en kandidaten. HBO werk- en denkniveau. Pré: ervaring met fysiotherapie. Woonachtig in Groningen of omgeving. Vloeiende beheersing van de Duitse taal (B2/C1 niveau). Goede kennis van Engels en redelijke kennis van Nederlands, extra talen zijn mooi meegenomen. Pré: werkervaring in de zorg. Benefits Wat bieden wij? Actief en gezellig team met een moderne werkomgeving. Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk. Gezellige teamuitjes en trips naar Zwitserland. Werklaptop, telefoon en een goed gevulde koelkast. Goed salaris. Een baan voor langere tijd. Interesse? Extra info over PhysioMatch: PhysioMatch is gespecialiseerd in het bemiddelen van zorgprofessionals, zoals fysiotherapeuten, ergotherapeuten en verpleegkundigen, voor diverse instellingen in Zwitserland. We zorgen voor de ideale match tussen professionals en zorginstellingen, waarbij we de nadruk leggen op persoonlijke begeleiding. Een voorbeeld van een dag bij PhysioMatch: Elke dag is anders bij PhysioMatch, maar er is altijd een goede mix van focus, teamwork, en zelfstandigheid. 08:30 - Begin van de werkdag Je pakt een bak heet water met een smaakje en checkt je e-mails en agenda ter voorbereiding op de dagstart. 09:00 - Dagstart Het team komt samen voor de dagelijkse meeting. Eerst kletsen we uitgebreid bij en dan worden de prioriteiten van de dag besproken en de sollicitanten verdeeld. 09:30 - Vacatureteksten en werving Na de meeting ga je aan de slag met het schrijven en plaatsen van vacatures in het Duits, Engels en Nederlands. 11:00 - Sollicitatiegesprek Je voert een online sollicitatiegesprek met een therapeut die geïnteresseerd is in een functie in Zwitserland. Middelharnis, Netherlands | Thermoheat B.V.

Join Thermoheat B.V. and help shape the future of HR in an international industrial environment.

We are looking for a HR Generalist (m/f/d) to support and develop our HR processes across the Thermoheat Group. This is a part-time position (20–25 hours/week).

Company Overview

Thermoheat B.V. is an established company with over 40 years of experience in the refractory industry and part of the internationally active LOEWE Group, a family-owned business founded in 1962.

With locations in the Netherlands and Portugal, Thermoheat delivers tailor-made refractory solutions for industrial clients worldwide. Our core markets include petrochemical, steel, aluminum, non-ferrous metals, energy, waste incineration, ceramics and glass.

Our portfolio covers the full range of refractory products and services, including thermal seals, refractory pre-shapes, and passive fire protection systems, all from a single source.

We are VCA certified, ISO 9001:2015 compliant, and audited according to NEN 4400-1, ensuring the highest standards in quality, safety, and compliance.

Your Role

You will take ownership of both operational HR tasks and strategic HR initiatives, working closely with management to strengthen our organization and people development.

Key Responsibilities

HR Strategy & Policies


  • Develop and improve HR policies across the group
  • Ensure compliance with Dutch and EU labor law
  • Support HR projects and organizational development initiatives


Operational HR Management


  • Advise management on HR-related topics
  • Manage end-to-end recruitment and hiring processes
  • Coordinate onboarding and employee development programs
  • Maintain job descriptions, compensation structures and performance processes
  • Collaborate with international teams (e.g. Portugal)


HR Administration


  • Maintain employee records, contracts and HR systems
  • Support payroll preparation with external providers
  • Manage absences (vacation, sick leave, etc.)
  • Prepare HR reports (headcount, turnover, KPIs)
  • Act as a point of contact for employee inquiries


Your Profile


  • Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or similar
  • Minimum 2 years of HR experience (HR Generalist or similar role)
  • Knowledge of labor law (NL/EU preferred)
  • Experience with MS Office and HR systems
  • Fluent in English and Dutch


What We Offer


  • Competitive salary package and attractive corporate benefits
  • Full-time equivalent salary: €4,000–€4,500 per month
  • Permanent role in a stable, internationally operating company
  • Professional training and development opportunities
  • Flexible working conditions
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Long-term perspective within a family-owned industrial group

title: AI Platform Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Netherlands. Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems. Accountabilities You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include: Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews. Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services. Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously. Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies. Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes. Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance. Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels. Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools. Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines. Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them. Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include: At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review. Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users. Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code. Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks. Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls. Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies. Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password. Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code. Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring. Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust. Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts. Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs. Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts. A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones. A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments. Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use. Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies. Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi. Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access. Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems. Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing. Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure. Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents. Benefits Remote-first work environment: Join a globally distributed workforce and work remotely. Health insurance: Access medical, dental, and vision coverage, with employee and dependent coverage fully provided in certain countries, depending on the applicable plan. Retirement benefits: Benefit from a company-matched 401(k) contribution of up to 3% for eligible employees in the United States. Home office allowance: Receive a one-time allowance of $1,500 to set up your home workspace. Professional development: Access an annual book allowance of $200 to support continuous learning. Connectivity reimbursement: Receive $75 per month toward internet or phone expenses. Flexible time off: Benefit from flexible paid time off arrangements. Work equipment: Receive a company-issued laptop. Well-being support: Access egg-freezing benefits, mental health resources, and employee wellness programs. Inclusive workplace: Work in an environment committed to equal opportunity, accessibility, and providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). raw.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
raw.description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice  die de productkwaliteit borgen

title: Security Architect
description: Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.     Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters   At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas:  Physical/embedded device security.  OT (operational technology) network security.  OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications.  Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.   What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun.  As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact.  What you will be doing   As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.  As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors.  Security standards, policies, and design patterns library  Security architecture review process  Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation  Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register  Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services.  Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies)  Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape  Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites.  Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.   To succeed in this role:   You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will".  You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. raw.title: Security Architect
raw.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.
